cohort: 40 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa at 34 weeks gestation and requiring cesarean delivery
finding: The use of prophylactic internal iliac artery balloon occlusion in placenta previa patients undergoing cesarean delivery did not reduce postpartum hemorrhage or have any effect on maternal or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: This study found no significant differences in intraoperative blood loss, length of surgery, or need for blood transfusion during cesarean delivery for placenta previa between women who underwent prophylactic internal iliac artery balloon occlusion and those who received standard management.
